archetypes.name: dyn-realized-matching
archetypes.rationale: Conservative matching and temporal ordering drive decisive voter alignment.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ground-truth matching helpers in python/analyze_issues.py. Focus on path extraction, token overlap, manifest started_at ordering, same-run round ordering, and whether decisive buckets can be overcounted or underqualified. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-oos-verdicts
archetypes.rationale: Accepted-OOS fate scoring must not conflate out_of_scope prose with panel acceptance.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the OOS row routing and oos_panel_verdict binding. Check that only accepted OOS rows can produce decisive docked buckets, rejected/provisional/ambiguous OOS evidence stays non-decisive, and existing fate-adjusted OOS scoring remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-voter-prep
archetypes.rationale: The new shared prep helper must preserve live voting behavior while exposing raw TSV context.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/voting.py and its call sites. Verify classification_row_panel_inputs mirrors existing TSV parsing without changing live tally or scoreboard semantics, and that ground-truth metrics use only voter/vote/missing rather than panel agree/disagree bits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
